text: 科创50指数涨超9%，创业板指涨超6%，沪指涨1.93%，深成指涨3.93%，贵金属、光伏、半导体芯片、医药生物等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近4700只。
text_en: The STAR 50 Index rose more than 9%, the ChiNext Index rose more than 6%, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.93%, and the Shenzhen Component Index rose 3.93%. Precious metals, photovoltaics, semiconductor chips, pharmaceuticals and biologics led the gains, with nearly 4,700 stocks rising in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
